Finding: Straight to Hell was the first ever country music release to merit the Parental Advisory library's label.

This revelation was made when comparing Straight to Hell, a musical effort led by actor and activist Hank Williams Jr., and assessing the history of parental advisory labels across different artists and genres within the same era. While several bands did receive parental advisory advisories, Straight to Hell stands out as the pioneer because it was Williams' debut release and a groundbreaking move towards mainstream adoption, especially considering his background in traditional country music.
